quotes.text: Use SpecialPowers.pushPrefEnv() instead of directly setting preferences in browser tests.

text: Enforced at the inspected source revision: browser tests use awaited SpecialPowers.pushPrefEnv for preference changes and its clear form for removing a pref. This restores state through the test environment.
title: Use pushPrefEnv for browser-test preference changes
